description: Just a curious mind trying to make sense of a universe full of possibilities.
summary:
OUTPOST 214 is a browser-based 3D Mars survival and colony management game designed to introduce young explorers to the challenges of living on another planet. Players take the role of a mission commander, travel to Mars, establish an outpost, and make important decisions to keep their crew alive.

The game combines exploration, resource management, and interactive storytelling. Players manage oxygen, food, and power while responding to challenges such as dust storms, radiation alerts, and greenhouse problems. Each decision has consequences that influence resources and the mission outcome.

OUTPOST 214 turns space science into an interactive learning experience, helping young players understand the challenges of Mars exploration and the importance of planning, teamwork, and scientific decision-making.
details:
OUTPOST 214: A Mission Beyond Earth is an interactive 3D Mars survival and exploration game developed to introduce players to the scientific and operational challenges of establishing a human settlement on Mars.

HOW IT WORKS

Players begin by registering as a mission commander, selecting their destination, and experiencing a cinematic spacecraft landing on Mars. Once on the surface, they explore a 3D Martian environment as an astronaut and take responsibility for maintaining a functioning outpost.

The game features three playable missions:
• First Landing – 8 Sols
• Long Stay – 12 Sols
• Radiation Season – 10 Sols

Players must manage four essential survival indicators: air, power, food, and radiation. They can mine water ice, operate oxygen-generating equipment, clean solar panels, maintain machinery, monitor communications, and take shelter during radiation events and environmental emergencies.

NASA SCIENCE INTEGRATION

The game includes a dedicated NASA Mission Data interface. It retrieves recent solar energetic particle and coronal mass ejection observations through NASA's DONKI API and searches NASA's Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) for spaceflight biology and human-health research.

NASA Mars facts are also incorporated to provide scientific context. Live solar observations are presented for educational purposes; in-game radiation and environmental events are simulated rather than direct real-time Mars measurements.

TECHNOLOGY USED

The project was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with Three.js (WebGL) for 3D graphics and environmental rendering. Web Audio API generates sound effects, while the browser's Speech Synthesis API provides mission narration.

CREATIVITY AND IMPACT

Unlike a conventional space-science quiz or slideshow, OUTPOST 214 offers an interactive survival experience. Players learn through exploration, resource management, and the consequences of their decisions.

The project aims to encourage scientific curiosity, strategic thinking, and interest in planetary exploration among younger audiences.

DEVELOPMENT

OUTPOST 214 was developed by Team Rebels (Maleeha and Fatima) during the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge.
